question: Capable of being understood in either of two or more possible senses, and therefore not definite
explanation: Ambiguous means “संदिग्ध / अस्पष्ट”. Example: His ambiguous statement confused everyone.

question: Whose name is not known / An unknown author
explanation: Anonymous means “नाम/लेखक अज्ञात”. Example: The letter was sent by an anonymous person.

question: A person who renounces a religious or political belief
explanation: Apostate means “धर्म/विश्वास त्यागने वाला”. Example: He was branded an apostate after abandoning his former religious beliefs.

question: One who makes an official examination of accounts or financial records
explanation: Auditor means “लेखापरीक्षक”. Example: The auditor examined the company's financial records.

question: A person who can speak only two languages
explanation: Bilingual means “दो भाषाएँ बोलने वाला”. Example: She is bilingual and can speak Hindi and English fluently.

question: Words uttered impiously about God / The act of speaking irreverently about God
explanation: Blasphemy means “ईश्वर के प्रति अपमानजनक या अनादरपूर्ण कथन”. Example: The remarks were condemned as blasphemy.

question: The scientific study of plants and their structure
explanation: Botany means “वनस्पति विज्ञान”. Example: Botany deals with the study of plants.

question: An arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present
explanation: Bouquet means “फूलों का गुच्छा / गुलदस्ता”. Example: She received a beautiful bouquet of roses.

question: A person who works with you at the same place, in a profession or a business
explanation: Colleague means “सहकर्मी”. Example: My colleague helped me complete the project.

question: Gradual recovery of health and strength
explanation: Convalescence means “बीमारी के बाद स्वास्थ्य लाभ”. Example: The patient spent several weeks in convalescence after the operation.

question: A person who readily believes others
explanation: Credulous means “विश्वास करने वाला / आसानी से विश्वास करने वाला”. Example: The credulous man believed the false story without checking it.

question: A doctor who studies and treats skin diseases
explanation: Dermatologist means “त्वचा रोग विशेषज्ञ”. Example: I visited a dermatologist for my skin problem.

question: A food item that is fit to be eaten
explanation: Edible means “खाने योग्य”. Example: Make sure that the mushrooms are edible before cooking them.

question: Widespread outbreak of a disease which affects large populations at the same time
explanation: Epidemic means “महामारी / किसी क्षेत्र में रोग का व्यापक फैलाव”. Example: The region faced an epidemic of dengue.

question: A person motivated by irrational enthusiasm
explanation: Fanatic means “कट्टरपंथी / अत्यधिक उत्साही व्यक्ति”. Example: The fanatic supporter refused to accept any criticism of his team.

question: Plants and vegetation of a particular region
explanation: Flora means “वनस्पति / किसी क्षेत्र के पौधे”. Example: The flora of the Himalayan region is extremely diverse.

question: A person who has escaped from captivity
explanation: Fugitive means “भगोड़ा”. Example: The police searched the area for the escaped fugitive.

question: The study of earth, including the origin and history of its rocks and soil
explanation: Geology means “भूविज्ञान”. Example: Geology helps us understand the formation of rocks and the structure of the Earth.

question: That which cannot be believed
explanation: Incredible means “विश्वास करने योग्य नहीं / अविश्वसनीय”. Example: The witness told an incredible story.

question: Incapable of feeling tired or exhausted
explanation: Indefatigable means “अथक / जिसे थकाया न जा सके”. Example: The indefatigable worker continued working throughout the day.

question: That can burn or catch fire easily
explanation: Inflammable means “आसानी से आग पकड़ने वाला”. Example: Petrol is an inflammable liquid.

question: That which cannot be called back
explanation: Irrevocable means “अपरिवर्तनीय / जिसे वापस न लिया जा सके”. Example: He made an irrevocable decision to resign.

question: Giving undue favours to one's own kith and kin
explanation: Nepotism means “अपने रिश्तेदारों को अनुचित लाभ देना”. Example: The minister was accused of nepotism after appointing several relatives.

question: A person who is new to a profession without training or experience in a skill or subject
explanation: Novice means “नौसिखिया / अनुभवहीन व्यक्ति”. Example: As a novice programmer, he was still learning the basics.

question: The study or collection of coins
explanation: Numismatics means “मुद्राशास्त्र / सिक्कों का अध्ययन”. Example: He developed an interest in numismatics and collected ancient coins.

question: A notice of a person's death
explanation: Obituary means “शोक-संदेश / मृत्यु-सूचना”. Example: The newspaper published an obituary of the famous writer.

question: One who sees bright side of things
explanation: Optimist means “आशावादी”. Example: An optimist always looks for positive possibilities even in difficult situations.

question: A person who opposes war or the use of military force
explanation: Pacifist means “शांतिवादी”. Example: The pacifist opposed the use of military force to solve the conflict.

question: A person who does not like, understand or enjoy the beauty of art, literature, music, etc.
explanation: Philistine means “कला और संस्कृति के प्रति अरुचि रखने वाला”. Example: The philistine showed no interest in classical music or art.

question: Stealing of ideas or writings of someone else
explanation: Plagiarism means “साहित्यिक चोरी”. Example: The student was punished for plagiarism after copying another writer's work.

question: Government by the richest people of a country
explanation: Plutocracy means “धनिक तंत्र / अमीर लोगों का शासन”. Example: The country was criticised for becoming a plutocracy dominated by wealthy elites.

question: The scientific study of the mind and how it influences behaviour
explanation: Psychology means “मनोविज्ञान”. Example: Psychology studies human thoughts, emotions and behaviour.

question: A person who withdraws from the world to live in seclusion and often in solitude
explanation: Recluse means “एकांतवासी”. Example: The old man lived as a recluse in a remote village.

question: A close-fitting cover for a sword or knife / Cover for the blade of a weapon or tool
explanation: Sheath means “म्यान / हथियार की धार का आवरण”. Example: The soldier carefully placed the sword in its sheath.

question: Something kept as a reminder of an event
explanation: Souvenir means “निशानी / स्मृति-चिह्न”. Example: I bought a small souvenir to remember my trip to Jaipur.

question: In exactly the same words as were used originally
explanation: Verbatim means “शब्दशः / ठीक उन्हीं शब्दों में”. Example: The reporter quoted the minister verbatim.

question: A person who is long experienced or practised in an activity
explanation: Veteran means “अनुभवी व्यक्ति”. Example: The veteran officer had served in the army for more than twenty years.

question: A decorative ring of flowers and leaves
explanation: Wreath means “फूलों की माला / पुष्पमाला”. Example: They placed a wreath at the memorial.

question: Fear of great heights
explanation: Acrophobia means “ऊँचाई का डर”. Example: His acrophobia prevents him from standing on tall buildings.

question: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty
explanation: Aesthetic means “सौंदर्य संबंधी”. Example: The architect paid special attention to the aesthetic appeal of the building.

question: A list of items to be discussed at a meeting
explanation: Agenda means “कार्यसूची”. Example: The chairman circulated the agenda before the meeting.

question: A medicine to nullify the effect of poison or another medicine
explanation: Antidote means “विष नाशक”. Example: The doctor administered an antidote to counteract the poison.

question: Animals and plants growing or living in, or near water
explanation: Aquatic means “जलीय”. Example: Fish and many water plants are aquatic organisms.

question: One who denies oneself ordinary bodily pleasures
explanation: Ascetic means “संयमी / सांसारिक सुखों का त्याग करने वाला”. Example: The ascetic lived a simple life and avoided material pleasures.

question: A person engaged in or trained for spaceflight
explanation: Astronaut means “अंतरिक्ष यात्री”. Example: The astronaut spent six months aboard the space station.

question: The scientific study of celestial bodies like the sun, moon, stars, planets, etc.
explanation: Astronomy means “खगोल शास्त्र”. Example: Astronomy studies stars, planets, galaxies and other celestial objects.

question: A doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases
explanation: Cardiologist means “हृदय रोग विशेषज्ञ”. Example: The cardiologist examined the patient's heart condition.

question: Animals that eat meat
explanation: Carnivorous means “मांसभक्षी”. Example: Lions are carnivorous animals that mainly eat meat.

question: A place where gambling games are played
explanation: Casino means “जुआघर”. Example: The tourists visited a casino where various gambling games were played.

question: A list or collection of books or informative graphics
explanation: Catalogue means “सूची”. Example: The library catalogue contains details of all available books.

question: A funeral procession
explanation: Cortege means “शव-यात्रा”. Example: A large cortege followed the hearse to the cemetery.

question: Centre of attraction
explanation: Cynosure means “आकर्षण का केंद्र”. Example: The talented singer became the cynosure of all eyes.

question: A leader who sways his followers by his oratory
explanation: Demagogue means “जनोत्तेजक नेता”. Example: The demagogue gained support by making emotional speeches.

question: The study of population and its dynamics
explanation: Demography means “जनसांख्यिकी”. Example: Demography studies population size, structure, birth rates and migration.

question: A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution
explanation: Dormitory means “शयनागार / सामूहिक सोने का कमरा”. Example: The students stayed together in a large dormitory.

question: A game in which no one wins
explanation: Draw means “अनिर्णीत मुकाबला”. Example: The football match ended in a draw.

question: A book or set of books giving information about all areas of knowledge
explanation: Encyclopedia means “विश्वकोश”. Example: I consulted an encyclopedia to learn about ancient civilisations.

question: Murder of one's brother or sister
explanation: Fratricide means “भ्रातृहत्या / भाई या बहन की हत्या”. Example: The ancient story describes an act of fratricide between two brothers.

question: A very small village
explanation: Hamlet means “छोटा गाँव”. Example: He grew up in a small hamlet surrounded by hills.

question: A building in which aircraft are housed
explanation: Hangar means “विमानशाला”. Example: The aircraft was kept safely inside the hangar.

question: All things or people of the same or similar kind or nature
explanation: Homogeneous means “सजातीय / एक ही प्रकार का”. Example: The group was homogeneous in terms of language and culture.

question: The study of growing garden plants
explanation: Horticulture means “उद्यान-विज्ञान”. Example: She studied horticulture to learn how to grow ornamental plants.

question: That which cannot be satisfied
explanation: Insatiable means “अतृप्त / जिसकी संतुष्टि न हो सके”. Example: He has an insatiable desire for knowledge.

question: Someone who is killed fighting for the cause of religion or faith
explanation: Martyr means “शहीद”. Example: The people honoured the martyr who sacrificed his life for his cause.

question: A place for keeping dead bodies before burial or cremation
explanation: Mortuary means “शवगृह”. Example: The body was taken to the mortuary before the funeral.

question: Present everywhere
explanation: Omnipresent means “सर्वव्यापक / हर जगह मौजूद”. Example: In the digital age, smartphones seem almost omnipresent.

question: The scientific study of birds
explanation: Ornithology means “पक्षीविज्ञान”. Example: Ornithology is the scientific study of birds.

question: A fictitious name especially one assumed by an author
explanation: Pseudonym means “उपनाम / लेखक द्वारा अपनाया गया काल्पनिक नाम”. Example: The author published his novels under a pseudonym.

question: Dress with medals, ribbons worn at official ceremony / Symbols of royalty
explanation: Regalia means “राजचिह्न / पदवी-चिह्न”. Example: The king appeared in ceremonial regalia at the official event.

question: A person very reserved in speech
explanation: Reticent means “अल्पभाषी / बोलने में संकोची”. Example: The reticent student rarely spoke during class discussions.

question: One who helps a person in need
explanation: Samaritan means “नेक आदमी / जरूरतमंद की मदद करने वाला”. Example: A good Samaritan helped the injured man on the roadside.

question: An office with high salary but no work
explanation: Sinecure means “आराम की नौकरी / बिना काम का पद”. Example: The position was criticised as a sinecure because it offered a salary without any real duties.

question: The study of the nature of God and religious beliefs / The study of religion
explanation: Theology means “धर्मशास्त्र / धार्मिक विश्वासों का अध्ययन”. Example: He studied theology to understand religious doctrines.

question: A place where animals are slaughtered for consumption as food
explanation: Abattoir means “कसाईखाना”. Example: The animals were transported to the abattoir.

question: An official pardon / The formal act of liberating someone
explanation: Amnesty means “राज-क्षमा / आधिकारिक क्षमादान”. Example: The government announced an amnesty for certain political prisoners.

question: A system of government of a country in which one person has complete power
explanation: Autocracy means “तानाशाही / एक व्यक्ति का शासन”. Example: Under an autocracy, one ruler holds almost all political power.

question: A large bundle bound together for storage or transport
explanation: Bale means “गट्ठर”. Example: The farmer loaded several bales of cotton onto the truck.

question: One who is unable to pay his debts
explanation: Bankrupt means “दिवालिया”. Example: The businessman was declared bankrupt after failing to repay his debts.

question: An instrument used for measuring atmospheric pressure
explanation: Barometer means “वायुदाबमापी”. Example: A barometer is used to measure atmospheric pressure.

question: A group of girls, women or birds
explanation: Bevy means “लड़कियों, महिलाओं या पक्षियों का समूह”. Example: A bevy of young women gathered outside the hall.

question: A list of books referred to in a scholarly work
explanation: Bibliography means “संदर्भित पुस्तकों की सूची”. Example: The researcher added a bibliography at the end of the thesis.

question: A government run by officials in a state
explanation: Bureaucracy means “नौकरशाही”. Example: Excessive bureaucracy can delay important government decisions.

question: Harsh or discordant sound / A loud confusing mixture of sounds
explanation: Cacophony means “कर्कश ध्वनि / शोर का मिश्रण”. Example: The traffic produced a cacophony of horns and engines.

question: A person who is skilled at producing beautiful handwriting
explanation: Calligrapher means “सुलेखक”. Example: The calligrapher wrote the wedding invitation beautifully.

question: A person who draws or makes maps
explanation: Cartographer means “मानचित्रकार”. Example: The cartographer prepared a detailed map of the region.

question: A person who plans and arranges dance movements
explanation: Choreographer means “नृत्य-निर्देशक”. Example: The choreographer created the dance sequence for the film.

question: A disease that can be spread from one person to another
explanation: Contagious means “संक्रामक”. Example: The doctor warned that the disease was highly contagious.

question: One who sees only selfishness and distrusts human motives
explanation: Cynic means “मानव स्वभाव के प्रति अविश्वासी व्यक्ति”. Example: The cynic believed that people usually acted only for personal benefit.

question: A system of government in which all citizens can vote to elect their representatives
explanation: Democracy means “लोकतंत्र”. Example: In a democracy, citizens elect their representatives through voting.
